shared_training_contract.gpu_constraint: physical CUDA device 1, NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3070 Ti only

joint_development_success_rule: Candidate target NLL must be lower than recipe-matched Stage-A random and external WikiText NLL must not exceed base no-update.
utility_scope: Stage C validation only; never selector objective
selection_rule: A joint-pass recipe may become a fresh confirmatory candidate only; development results cannot certify it.
claim_boundary: Development recipe evidence only; no deployment, certification, task-capability, or universal-recipe claim.
